definition_en: used when choosing the best-supported cause or answer
definition_es: se usa para elegir la causa o respuesta mejor sustentada
example_en: Which condition is most likely to cause the malfunction?

definition_en: the action that must occur before the other listed actions
definition_es: la acción que debe ocurrir antes que las demás
example_en: What should the electrician do first?

definition_en: before an action or event
definition_es: antes de una acción o evento
example_en: Verify the required condition prior to commissioning.

definition_en: in conformity with a stated source or requirement
definition_es: de conformidad con una fuente o requisito indicado
example_en: Evaluate the result according to the applicable specification.

definition_en: confirm that a condition or result is correct
definition_es: confirmar que una condición o resultado es correcto
example_en: Verify system operation after maintenance.

definition_en: establish a result through inspection, calculation or testing
definition_es: establecer un resultado mediante inspección, cálculo o prueba
example_en: Determine the source of the malfunction.

definition_en: recognize and correctly name or locate something
definition_es: reconocer y nombrar o localizar correctamente algo
example_en: Identify the applicable isolation points.

definition_en: a condition in which equipment does not operate as intended
definition_es: condición en la que un equipo no opera como se espera
example_en: Document a detailed description of the malfunction.

definition_en: an on-site assessment used in troubleshooting or maintenance
definition_es: evaluación en sitio usada para diagnóstico o mantenimiento
example_en: Compare the field assessment with diagnostic results.

definition_en: test instruments used to find and evaluate faults
definition_es: instrumentos usados para localizar y evaluar fallas
example_en: Select diagnostic test equipment appropriate to the task.

definition_en: activities that verify a system is ready to operate as intended
definition_es: actividades que verifican que un sistema está listo para operar
example_en: Compare maintenance results with commissioning documentation.

definition_en: activities used to safely remove a system from service
definition_es: actividades para retirar un sistema de servicio de forma segura
example_en: Follow the facility procedure during decommissioning.

definition_en: a drawing updated to reflect the installed condition
definition_es: plano actualizado para reflejar la condición instalada
example_en: Update the as-built drawing after an approved change.

definition_en: technical requirements supplied by the equipment manufacturer
definition_es: requisitos técnicos proporcionados por el fabricante
example_en: Compare the measured result with manufacturer specifications.

definition_en: planned timing and scope of maintenance tasks
definition_es: planificación de tiempos y alcance del mantenimiento
example_en: Record the test result in the maintenance schedule.

definition_en: a component selected to replace a defective or damaged part
definition_es: componente seleccionado para sustituir una pieza defectuosa
example_en: Select an OEM or equivalent replacement component.

definition_en: the measured or observed outcome of a test
definition_es: resultado medido u observado de una prueba
example_en: Compare the test result with previous records.

definition_en: a pattern in measured values over time
definition_es: patrón de valores medidos a través del tiempo
example_en: Analyze the signal trend to verify integrity.

definition_en: the condition of being complete, reliable and fit for intended operation
definition_es: condición de ser completo, confiable y apto para operar
example_en: Verify the integrity of the analog signal.

definition_en: physical control that prevents operation of an energy-isolation device
definition_es: control físico que impide operar un dispositivo de aislamiento
example_en: Follow the facility lock-out procedure.

definition_en: identification applied to an isolation device to communicate its status
definition_es: identificación aplicada a un dispositivo de aislamiento
example_en: Apply tag-out according to facility policy.

definition_en: a verified condition in which hazardous energy has been controlled
definition_es: condición verificada en la que la energía peligrosa ha sido controlada
example_en: Confirm the zero-energy state before work begins.

definition_en: energy remaining in equipment after the primary source has been isolated
definition_es: energía que permanece después de aislar la fuente principal
example_en: Identify stored energy during the hazard assessment.

definition_en: the process of identifying hazards and appropriate risk controls
definition_es: proceso de identificar peligros y controles de riesgo
example_en: Complete the hazard assessment before the task.

definition_en: a simplified representation of an electrical power system
definition_es: representación simplificada de un sistema eléctrico de potencia
example_en: Trace the feeder on the single-line diagram.

definition_en: a drawing showing functional electrical relationships
definition_es: diagrama que muestra relaciones eléctricas funcionales
example_en: Use the schematic to trace the control circuit.

definition_en: a diagram showing physical conductor connections
definition_es: diagrama que muestra conexiones físicas de conductores
example_en: Compare the wiring diagram with the field wiring.

definition_en: the point where electrical supply is delivered to an installation
definition_es: punto donde la alimentación eléctrica se entrega a una instalación
example_en: Review the service entrance arrangement.

definition_en: equipment used to measure electrical supply or consumption
definition_es: equipo usado para medir alimentación o consumo eléctrico
example_en: Inspect the metering equipment against the drawing.

definition_en: equipment that responds to overcurrent to protect circuits and equipment
definition_es: equipo que responde a sobrecorriente para proteger circuitos y equipos
example_en: Evaluate the protection device using test records.

definition_en: current above the allowed or expected value
definition_es: corriente superior al valor permitido o esperado
example_en: An overcurrent condition may require protective action.

definition_en: a switching and overcurrent-protection device
definition_es: dispositivo de maniobra y protección contra sobrecorriente
example_en: Compare breaker test results with commissioning data.

definition_en: an overcurrent device that opens by melting an element
definition_es: dispositivo de sobrecorriente que abre al fundirse un elemento
example_en: A fuse is one type of overcurrent protection device.

definition_en: electrical resistance measured across closed contacts
definition_es: resistencia eléctrica medida a través de contactos cerrados
example_en: Compare contact-resistance results with previous records.

definition_en: connection of a system or equipment to ground for an intended electrical function
definition_es: conexión de un sistema o equipo a tierra para una función eléctrica
example_en: Review the grounding system as part of Task B-11.

definition_en: electrical connection of conductive parts to maintain continuity and equalize potential
definition_es: conexión eléctrica de partes conductoras para mantener continuidad y equipotencialidad
example_en: Inspect bonding connections for continuity.

definition_en: an unintended conductive path to ground or grounded parts
definition_es: trayectoria conductora no intencional hacia tierra o partes aterrizadas
example_en: Analyze the ground-fault protection system.

definition_en: electrical equipment that transfers energy between circuits by electromagnetic induction
definition_es: equipo que transfiere energía entre circuitos por inducción electromagnética
example_en: Compare transformer maintenance results with baseline data.

definition_en: the relationship between primary and secondary winding turns or corresponding voltages
definition_es: relación entre vueltas o voltajes de primario y secundario
example_en: Evaluate the transformer turn-ratio result.

definition_en: the relative electrical orientation of terminals or signals
definition_es: orientación eléctrica relativa de terminales o señales
example_en: Verify polarity against drawings and device information.
